policy: Discovery does not authorize removal. Only individually selected regular files matching an enabled handler, current identity, supported on-disk format, content checks, and inactive writer checks can enter a Trash plan. Unknown layouts remain report-only.

rules.applicability: Only the content-v2/sha512/2-hex/2-hex/124-hex on-disk layout. No assumption about other npm/cacache versions or configured cache locations.
checks: regular owned file with one hard link
matching scanned identity and ancestor identities
SHA-512 content matches all three filename segments
no Node/npm/pnpm/yarn/bun writer reported by a fresh process snapshot
bounded content verification; unknown or oversized items remain report-only
rules.effects: Moves a selected cached blob to Trash. npm may need network access to fetch it again; do not select copies required for offline work. The cache index is retained and may contain a cache miss until npm refreshes it.
rules.validation: Disposable content-addressed fixtures; this is a narrow format-specific file handler, not a complete npm cache manager.

rules.applicability: Known default locations only; pip configuration and newer formats can change them.
rules.effects: Review only. Use a separately supported pip cache operation after checking the active environment and offline requirements.
rules.validation: Discovery fixtures only; direct removal is disabled.

rules.applicability: Default Gradle User Home only; GRADLE_USER_HOME and cache format versions may differ.
rules.effects: Review only. Gradle owns cache lifetime and version-specific cleanup; no direct file removal is enabled.
rules.validation: Discovery fixtures only; Gradle's own lifecycle rules are not reproduced.

rules.applicability: Default module-cache location only; compiler/developer settings may relocate it.
rules.effects: Review only until a toolchain-specific removal adapter proves inactivity and regeneration. Directory name or .pcm extension alone does not enable removal.
rules.validation: Discovery fixtures only; no managed Xcode resources are removed.

rules.applicability: Discovery lead from installed-app inspection; Spotify app versions and configured paths are not validated.
rules.effects: No removal is enabled: local/offline media must not be mistaken for regenerable cache.

rules.applicability: Static discovery leads only; no independently validated removal layouts or app versions.
rules.effects: No removal is enabled. Use each application's supported storage controls until a validated adapter exists.
rules.validation: Preservation fixtures only; competitor paths are not deletion rules.

rules.applicability: Only Cache, Code Cache, and GPUCache branches beneath a single app folder; this layout is not proof of Electron identity or a supported app version.
rules.effects: No removal is enabled. Each app needs independent identity, layout, and shutdown validation before a cache rule can be activated.

rules.applicability: Default/team Dropbox .dropbox.cache or File Provider group-container root-mount discovery; installed provider version and process shutdown are not validated.
rules.effects: No removal is enabled. Dropbox manages this staging area; safe cleanup depends on provider-specific shutdown and active-transfer state.
rules.validation: Discovery fixtures only; provider internals remain protected.

rules.applicability: Catch-all protection for unvalidated app data; no path name implies disposability.
exclusions: all data until covered by a supported exact rule
rules.effects: Inventory only; not selectable for cleanup through the generic file handler.
